name: a3_var_t
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 3 (Sec. 7.2, Table 4) - EFFECT OF THE FOUR CERTIFICATION-COST COMPONENTS, one at a time:
        fixed MRV  (Fix_MRV, $)            variable MRV  (Var_MRV, $/ha^delta)
        fixed transaction (Fix_T, $)       variable transaction (Var_T, $/farmer)
    C(S) = Fix_MRV + Var_MRV A(S)^delta + Fix_T + Var_T |S|  (Eqs. 10-12).  Fixed components penalise
    small coalitions (feasibility), the area-driven MRV term penalises large farms, and the per-farmer
    transaction term penalises large coalitions.  Paper grids: Fix_MRV 0/1000/2000/4000, Var_MRV
    0/45/65/80; the two transaction components are new.  A combined figure overlays the four
    components against a common x-axis "multiple of the baseline value" for direct comparison of
    elasticities.
